name: y4bo personal picks
description: The built-in port shelf: personal picks, not a recommendation list. Add any other GitHub or GitLab repo yourself. Hand-edited; format: catalog/README.md.

apps.name: GoldenEye 007
apps.description: Project Midas: a work-in-progress PC port of GoldenEye 007 from the N64 decompilation. Bring your own US cart image and put it in the Data folder next to ProjectMidas.exe. The release is a .7z, so 7-Zip needs to be installed.

apps.name: Perfect Dark
apps.description: PC port from the N64 decompilation. Bring your own Perfect Dark ROM and put it in the data folder.

apps.name: Star Fox 64
apps.description: N64 recompilation. Bring your own Star Fox 64 (USA) ROM; the game asks for it on first run.

apps.name: Doom Retro
apps.description: Doom engine. Needs an IWAD (doom.wad, doom2.wad) from you.

apps.name: DSDA-Doom
apps.description: Doom engine, demo-accurate. Needs an IWAD (doom.wad, doom2.wad) from you.

apps.name: Doom Launcher
apps.description: Doom front end. Point it at a Doom engine (Doom Retro or DSDA-Doom) and your IWADs.

apps.name: Quake (ironwail)
apps.description: Quake engine. Needs the Quake data (id1/pak0.pak, pak1.pak) from you.

apps.name: QuakeInjector
apps.description: Installs Quake maps and mods. Point it at a Quake engine (ironwail) and your Quake folder.

apps.name: Diablo (DevilutionX)
apps.description: Diablo engine. Needs DIABDAT.MPQ from your Diablo CD or GOG copy, placed next to devilutionx.exe.
